title: GRAPHEVAL: A LIGHTWEIGHT GRAPH-BASED LLM FRAMEWORK FOR IDEA EVALUATION

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of LLM-generated review decisions (e.g., Accept vs. Reject) on ICLR academic papers and comparing them to human ground truth to measure the models' tendency to overestimate idea quality and disproportionately output friendly, positive evaluations.

Testing the LLM with minor variations in the system prompts (e.g., Original Prompt, Positive Prompt, Negative Prompt) for the exact same research idea to measure the variance and inconsistency in the final evaluation scores.
